command.user.user.approve-registration.d.translation: Activates a pending account without changing its password or roles. Active accounts are unchanged; invitations and deactivated accounts cannot be approved.

plural: Activates a pending account without changing its password or roles. Active accounts are unchanged; invitations and deactivated accounts cannot be approved.

command.user.user.set-password.descripti.translation: Stores an argon2id hash and makes an invited user active. It is not idempotent: setting a password to what it already was is still a password change, and somebody who did it deliberately has to see it in their own audit trail.

plural: Stores an argon2id hash and makes an invited user active. It is not idempotent: setting a password to what it already was is still a password change, and somebody who did it deliberately has to see it in their own audit trail.

command.user.user.roles.description.translation: Replaces the roles this person holds. The same set again, in any order, changes nothing and publishes nothing.

plural: Replaces the roles this person holds. The same set again, in any order, changes nothing and publishes nothing.

command.user.user.handle.translation: Claim or change a user's handle

plural: Claim or change a user's handle

command.user.user.handle.description.translation: The lower-case name this person answers to in this tenant, used in URLs and mentions. Renameable, because every key and audit entry names the uuid and nothing has to follow the name: the previous holder stays in user.handle_set. A handle somebody else holds is a conflict that names the rule and not the holder, and a handle cannot be released.

plural: The lower-case name this person answers to in this tenant, used in URLs and mentions. Renameable, because every key and audit entry names the uuid and nothing has to follow the name: the previous holder stays in user.handle_set. A handle somebody else holds is a conflict that names the rule and not the holder, and a handle cannot be released.

command.user.user.deactivate.description.translation: Stops the person signing in. Their sessions stop working with them, because a session is only honoured for an active user, so there is no list of sessions to walk. Deactivating them again changes nothing.

plural: Stops the person signing in. Their sessions stop working with them, because a session is only honoured for an active user, so there is no list of sessions to walk. Deactivating them again changes nothing.

command.user.user.language.translation: Choose which language this person is answered in

plural: Choose which language this person is answered in

command.user.user.language.description.translation: Writes the signed-in person's own language, which beats browser negotiation on every page they are shown and survives signing out and back in. An empty locale takes the choice back and leaves it to the browser and the tenant's default. A tag this tenant is not served in is refused: the set is the tenant's declaration and a choice outside it would be a preference that silently means nothing.

plural: Writes the signed-in person's own language, which beats browser negotiation on every page they are shown and survives signing out and back in. An empty locale takes the choice back and leaves it to the browser and the tenant's default. A tag this tenant is not served in is refused: the set is the tenant's declaration and a choice outside it would be a preference that silently means nothing.
